Daughter Accused of Murdering Mother for Job and Property

A daughter in Jaipur is accused of plotting and carrying out the murder of her mother. The alleged motive for the crime was to gain control of government job benefits and significant property assets. Investigations are ongoing to uncover the details of the alleged conspiracy and the sequence of events.
